read.en: Marvell's trend is up: the 10, 30 and 100-day averages are rising and price is 12% above the 30-day ($246). The stock is up 46% in three months. The Oct 6 spike to $301 was sold, though, and the short-term signals have softened: Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Oct 8, the MACD histogram has shrunk for two sessions, and RSI eased from 70 to 61.
read.zh: Marvell 趋势向上：10 日、30 日和 100 日均线均上行，股价高出 30 日均线（$246）12%，三个月上涨 46%。不过 10月6日冲高至 $301 后遭抛售，短线信号转弱：抛物线 SAR 于 10月8日转空，MACD 柱体连续两日收缩，RSI 由 70 回落至 61。

read.en: $300–301 (June 30 and Oct 6 highs) is the ceiling; a close above it targets the June peak of $324–330. The first support is $266–268 (the Oct 8 and 9 lows). Below that, $245–255 (30-day average and late-August pivots) is where buyers stepped in during the September run.
read.zh: $300–301（6月30日与10月6日高点）为上方天花板；收盘突破后目标为 6月高点 $324–330。首个支撑为 $266–268（10月8、9日低点）。其下，$245–255（30 日均线与8月下旬转折点）是 9月上涨途中买盘进场的位置。
